description: This is a Java test class for testing advanced querying capabilities on data tables in the Apache Fineract project. It includes tests for creating data tables, inserting entries, and executing complex queries with filters, sorting, and pagination, specifically in the context of integration testing for savings transactions.

classes.name: DatatableAdvancedQueryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing advanced data table queries in Apache Fineract, including creating data tables, inserting entries, and executing complex filter and sort operations during integration testing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes RESTAssured specifications and helper objects before each test.

methods.name: testDatatableAdvancedQuery
methods.description: Creates a data table, populates it with savings transaction data, runs advanced queries with filters and sorts, and verifies the results.

methods.name: testApptableWithDatatableAdvancedQuery
methods.description: Performs similar operations as the previous test but using a different query approach to validate advanced querying on associated application tables.

methods.name: createAndVerifyDatatable
methods.description: Creates a new data table with specified parameters, validates its creation, and returns the identifier.

methods.name: createDatatableEntry
methods.description: Inserts a new entry into the specified data table with provided data values.

methods.name: deleteDatatable
methods.description: Deletes entries from a data table based on IDs and then deletes the data table itself.

methods.name: createSavingsProductDailyPosting
methods.description: Creates a savings product with daily interest posting and calculation settings.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountDailyPosting
methods.description: Creates and activates a savings account for testing, using the daily posting product.
